title: Backtesting Challenge
summary: Explain look-ahead, survivorship and overfitting, and test your own rules on data they were not tuned on. The checkpoint step accepts the testing checkpoint from either program.

criteria.label: Pass your program's testing checkpoint: Backtesting my plan (Practical Forex Trader) or Regimes, sizing and honest testing (Trader Development)
Answer 10 backtesting questions at 80% or better (latest answer to each)
Save 2 backtests that keep an out-of-sample part or period blocks
